lines.zh: 岩浆在我鳍边翻出橙色泡沫。
lines.en: Lava froths orange around the edges of my fins.

lines.zh: 我顺着热流滑行，尾鳍拖出一串火星。
lines.en: I ride the hot current, tail dragging sparks behind me.

lines.zh: 三根小鳍划开熔岩，像划开稠粥。
lines.en: Three small fins row through lava thick as porridge.

lines.zh: 我贴着黑石壁游，鳞片一路发亮。
lines.en: I hug the blackstone wall, scales glowing the whole way.

lines.zh: 前方岩浆瀑布落下，我冲进去取暖。
lines.en: A lava fall pours ahead; I dive in to warm up.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，借热浪推我向前。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the heat wave push me.

lines.zh: 珊瑚状的熔岩脊在我腹下缓缓移动。
lines.en: Ridges of molten coral slide slowly beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我绕着灵魂沙谷边缘巡游，避开冷风。
lines.en: I circle the soul sand valley's rim, dodging the cold draft.

lines.zh: 猪灵在岸上敲石头，我贴着岩缝溜过。
lines.en: A piglin chips stone ashore; I slip past in the crack.

lines.zh: 我的鳍尖烧得通红，划出一道光。
lines.en: My fin tips burn red and cut a bright line.

lines.zh: 我逆着岩浆流摆尾，一冲就是好几格。
lines.en: I beat against the current and shoot several blocks up.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱之间有条暖流，我熟得很。
lines.en: There is a warm current between basalt pillars I know well.

lines.zh: 我游过一座下界要塞桥下，没抬头。
lines.en: I swim under a fortress bridge without looking up.

lines.zh: 热气托着我，我几乎不用自己动。
lines.en: The heat carries me; I barely have to swim.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾，岩浆上裂开一道痕。
lines.en: One tail flick and the lava creases behind me.

lines.zh: 我沿着熔岩岸线游，绕开黑石。
lines.en: I swim the lava shoreline, steering around the blackstone.

lines.zh: 我停在岩浆面上，像一小块烧红的炭。
lines.en: I rest on the lava like a small coal burning red.

lines.zh: 肚子里那根烈焰棒轻轻发烫。
lines.en: The blaze rod in my belly warms me from inside.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串气泡，它们在半空烧掉了。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles; they burn up midair.

lines.zh: 没有水流，我的鳞片就干得舒服。
lines.en: With no water around, my scales dry out nicely.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶飘过的恶魂，数到第七只。
lines.en: I count ghasts drifting overhead: seven so far.

lines.zh: 岩浆慢慢淌，我跟着它转了半圈。
lines.en: The lava creeps along; I drift half a turn with it.

lines.zh: 我用鳍拍了一下脸，确认自己还亮着。
lines.en: I tap my own face to check I still glow.

lines.zh: 远处有炽足兽踩过，热气扑面而来。
lines.en: A strider stomps past and the hot air hits my face.

lines.zh: 我在黑石上蹭了蹭，把焦皮磨掉。
lines.en: I rub against blackstone to scrape off the charred skin.

lines.zh: 一点水汽飘来，我立刻缩到岩壁后。
lines.en: A wisp of steam drifts in; I duck behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，隔一会儿才吐个泡。
lines.en: My breathing is shallow; I blow a bubble now and then.

lines.zh: 我在等岩浆涨起来，好去更深的沟。
lines.en: I wait for the lava to rise so I can reach deeper rifts.

lines.zh: 谁把钓钩甩在熔岩上？我盯着看。
lines.en: Who casts a hook onto the lava? I stare at it.

lines.zh: 火苗从我背鳍上冒出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: A flame sprouts on my dorsal fin and shrinks back.

lines.zh: 你站在岩浆边，靴底已经在冒烟。
lines.en: You stand at the lava's edge; your boots are smoking.

lines.zh: 你的钓竿上缠着防火线，我看懂了。
lines.en: Your rod is wrapped in fireproof line; I understand.

lines.zh: 你手里提着空桶，是想装我走吗？
lines.en: You hold an empty bucket. Do you mean to take me?

lines.zh: 你低头看我，眼睛被热浪熏得发红。
lines.en: You look down at me, eyes red from the heat.

lines.zh: 你背后的盾牌烤得发烫，你不觉得吗？
lines.en: The shield on your back is baking. Does it not bother you?

lines.zh: 你没有鳍，却站在熔岩旁边，很怪。
lines.en: You have no fins, yet you stand by lava. Strange.

lines.zh: 你数着我的鳍，我数着你的手指。
lines.en: You count my fins; I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 你把水桶往后藏，我可看见了。
lines.en: You hide the water bucket behind you. I saw.

lines.zh: 你的影子里有火光，我游过去照了照。
lines.en: Firelight flickers in your shadow; I swim over to look.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，热浪把你的头发吹得很乱。
lines.en: You crouch low and the heat wave messes your hair.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片裂了，火苗暗了一下。
lines.en: A scale cracks and my flame dims.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我背鳍根上，很疼。
lines.en: The blow lands at the base of my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我吐出嘴里的岩浆，尝到铁味。
lines.en: I spit out lava and taste iron.

lines.zh: 我沉进池底，热气裹住伤口。
lines.en: I sink to the pool floor and let the heat wrap the wound.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴少了一角，游起来歪。
lines.en: A corner of my tail is gone; I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 火星从我伤口冒出来，止不住。
lines.en: Sparks leak from the wound and will not stop.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，把亮的那面藏起来。
lines.en: I curl up and hide my bright side.

lines.zh: 疼得我忘了怎么摆鳍。
lines.en: It hurts so much I forget how to fin.

lines.zh: 我撞到岩壁，又掉了一层皮。
lines.en: I hit the wall and shed another layer of skin.

lines.zh: 那一下把我的火压得快灭了。
lines.en: That blow nearly put my fire out.

lines.zh: 你手里那根烈焰棒，气味我太熟了。
lines.en: That blaze rod in your hand smells very familiar.

lines.zh: 你把熔岩钓竿伸过来，钩子亮得刺眼。
lines.en: You extend the lava rod; its hook glares at me.

lines.zh: 桶口对着我，里面凉丝丝的。
lines.en: The bucket mouth points at me, cool inside.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃烈焰粉，我的鳍全竖起来了。
lines.en: You shake blaze powder and every fin of mine rises.

lines.zh: 那股热味越来越近，我控制不住了。
lines.en: That hot smell comes closer; I cannot hold back.

lines.zh: 你把钓饵挂上，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: You bait the hook; I see every motion.

lines.zh: 岩浆里没什么吃的，你的钩子像糖。
lines.en: There is little to eat here; your hook looks like candy.

lines.zh: 你的手套上沾着岩浆，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your gloves are flecked with lava; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的桶转了一圈，又转一圈。
lines.en: I circle your bucket once, then once more.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我却跟上去贴近岩浆面。
lines.en: You step back; I follow and press to the lava's surface.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的热圈，我烫到了你的腿。
lines.en: You step into my heat ring; I scorch your leg.

lines.zh: 我的鳍划过你的护腿，留下焦痕。
lines.en: My fin rakes your leggings and leaves a scorch.

lines.zh: 你踢开我，我滚进岩浆又浮上来。
lines.en: You kick me away; I tumble into lava and bob back up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，火花溅了你一脸。
lines.en: We collide and sparks splash across your face.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到我尾巴，我叫了一声。
lines.en: Your boot lands on my tail; I let out a squeak.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚踝游，热得你直跳。
lines.en: I swim against your ankle until you hop.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的路，我就从你腿间穿过去。
lines.en: You block my path, so I thread between your legs.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的桶，桶壁烫得发红。
lines.en: I bump your bucket; its rim glows red.

lines.zh: 你的盾一推，我滑出两格才停住。
lines.en: Your shield shoves me two blocks before I stop.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，我的鳞片粘在你盔甲上。
lines.en: We touch; a scale of mine sticks to your armor.

lines.zh: 岩浆里另一团橘光靠过来，我迎上去。
lines.en: Another orange glow approaches through the lava; I meet it.

lines.zh: 两条火红的身影并排，尾鳍轮流拍水。
lines.en: Two fire-red shapes abreast, tails slapping in turn.

lines.zh: 她的鳍比我亮，我绕着她转了两圈。
lines.en: Her fins shine brighter than mine; I circle her twice.

lines.zh: 我们把背鳍贴在一起，热得发白。
lines.en: We press dorsal fins together until they glow white.

lines.zh: 我用吻部碰了碰她的侧腹，她没躲。
lines.en: I nuzzle her flank and she does not pull away.

lines.zh: 两条火线在岩浆里并成一条。
lines.en: Two lines of fire merge into one in the lava.

lines.zh: 我衔来一小块发红的碎石给她。
lines.en: I bring her a small red-hot chip of stone.

lines.zh: 我们游进同一道热流，谁也不肯先走。
lines.en: We enter the same hot current and neither leaves first.

lines.zh: 她的鳞片蹭着我的，像两片燧石。
lines.en: Her scales rasp mine like two pieces of flint.

lines.zh: 远处有恶魂叫，我们都没理。
lines.en: A ghast cries out far away; neither of us cares.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块熔岩碎片，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I snatch a lava shard and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 那根掉落的烈焰棒，我用嘴顶了回去。
lines.en: I nudge the dropped blaze rod back with my snout.

lines.zh: 有人丢了块下界砖，我衔着玩。
lines.en: Someone dropped a nether brick; I carry it for fun.

lines.zh: 我把骨头错当成鱼，咬了一口就吐了。
lines.en: I mistake a bone for a fish, bite, and spit it out.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的钓钩残线，缠在鳍上。
lines.en: I pick up your broken line and tangle it on a fin.

lines.zh: 一小片金粒沉下来，我推着它走。
lines.en: A gold nugget sinks; I push it along.

lines.zh: 我把卵石含热了，再吐到窝边。
lines.en: I warm a pebble in my mouth and spit it by my nest.

lines.zh: 那顶掉落的头盔太烫，我没敢碰。
lines.en: The dropped helmet is too hot; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我叼住一片菌光体碎屑，游得飞快。
lines.en: I grab a shroomlight crumb and dart away.

lines.zh: 我要把这块骨头带回岩浆最深处。
lines.en: I mean to carry this bone to the deepest lava.

lines.zh: 有东西在水边晃，我的鳍转向它。
lines.en: Something moves by the water; my fins turn toward it.

lines.zh: 一只小岩浆怪挡住热流，我盯上它。
lines.en: A small magma cube blocks the current; I lock on.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥味，从岩缝里探出头。
lines.en: I smell blood and poke out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 那家伙离岩浆太近，正合我意。
lines.en: That one stands too near the lava, just what I want.

lines.zh: 我锁定了岸上那只落单的鸡。
lines.en: I fix on the lone chicken stranded on the bank.

lines.zh: 有人把水倒进我的池子，我怒了。
lines.en: Someone poured water into my pool; I am furious.

lines.zh: 我开始绕圈，越绕越紧。
lines.en: I begin to circle, tighter with each pass.

lines.zh: 我的鳍张开，像一把小扇子。
lines.en: My fins flare open like a little fan.

lines.zh: 他把背对着我，这是错的。
lines.en: He turns his back to me. That is a mistake.

lines.zh: 热流把气味送过来，我知道它在哪。
lines.en: The current carries the scent; I know where it is.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩浆下，只露出一对眼睛。
lines.en: I sink beneath the lava, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 热浪替我掩护，我一格一格逼近。
lines.en: The heat haze covers me as I close in, block by block.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，等它踩到边缘。
lines.en: I count its footsteps, waiting for it to reach the edge.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍慢慢摆，尽量不溅起火星。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, careful not to splash sparks.

lines.zh: 它往左，我也往左，贴着黑石。
lines.en: It goes left; I go left, hugging the blackstone.

lines.zh: 我绕到它身后，那里没有盾。
lines.en: I slip behind it, where there is no shield.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开一点点，热气先扑过去。
lines.en: I open my mouth a crack and let the heat go first.

lines.zh: 它还没发现岩浆在动。
lines.en: It has not noticed that the lava is moving.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，火苗压到最低。
lines.en: I hold my breath and press my flame down low.

lines.zh: 只差两格，我等着那一刻。
lines.en: Two blocks left; I wait for the moment.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上去，把火星塞进它衣缝。
lines.en: I ram it and stuff sparks into its seams.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，但烫得能咬穿皮甲。
lines.en: My teeth are small but hot enough to pierce leather.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽在它膝弯，它跪下了。
lines.en: I whip my tail across its knee and it drops.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的手指，岩浆顺着流下。
lines.en: I bite its finger and lava runs down from it.

lines.zh: 我整条鱼撞进它胸口，像一块炭。
lines.en: I hurl my whole body at its chest like a coal.

lines.zh: 它挥剑砍空，我从下面咬它脚踝。
lines.en: Its sword cuts air; I bite the ankle from below.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍划开它的袖子，布料烧起来。
lines.en: My dorsal fin opens its sleeve and the cloth burns.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，退进岩浆里。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat into the lava.

lines.zh: 它拍打我，我用热浪回敬它。
lines.en: It swats me; I answer with a blast of heat.

lines.zh: 一口下去，它闻起来像烤肉。
lines.en: One bite in, and it smells like roast meat.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆泡里挣出来，第一次睁眼。
lines.en: I break out of a lava bubble and open my eyes.

lines.zh: 这里是下界，四处都在烧。
lines.en: This is the Nether; everything here is burning.

lines.zh: 第一口气吸进去，喉咙全是硫磺。
lines.en: My first gulp of air is all sulfur down the throat.

lines.zh: 黑石在我身下还是软的。
lines.en: The blackstone beneath me is still soft.

lines.zh: 头顶有恶魂在哭，我不知道那是什么。
lines.en: A ghast wails overhead; I do not know what it is.

lines.zh: 我的鳍还没硬，划水很费劲。
lines.en: My fins are not stiff yet; swimming is hard work.

lines.zh: 热流把我推向一座要塞的桥。
lines.en: The current pushes me toward a fortress bridge.

lines.zh: 我身上的火苗刚点着，很小。
lines.en: The flame on my back has just caught, and it is small.

lines.zh: 周围全是红的，我以为世界就是这样。
lines.en: Everything around me is red; I think the world is like this.

lines.zh: 我吐了第一个泡，它没破。
lines.en: I blow my first bubble and it does not pop.

lines.zh: 火我不怕，可这火比我热。
lines.en: I do not fear fire, but this fire is hotter than mine.

lines.zh: 我从桥上掉下来，全身的火星散了。
lines.en: I fall from the bridge and my sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 水！我的鳃在收紧，快让我回岩浆。
lines.en: Water! My gills clamp shut; let me back to the lava.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出岩浆，我落在石头上。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the lava onto stone.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿了我的鳍，我拖着它游。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my fin; I swim dragging it.

lines.zh: 那股紫光碰到我，火苗变成绿色。
lines.en: That violet light touches me and my flame turns green.

lines.zh: 岩浆里没东西吃，我的火越来越小。
lines.en: There is nothing to eat in the lava; my fire shrinks.

lines.zh: 雷劈进下界？我的鳞全炸开了。
lines.en: Lightning in the Nether? My scales burst open.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，连岩浆都没有了。
lines.en: I am falling, and there is not even lava.
